lines.en: Slow wings. Don't startle the flowers.
Black wings open and close—forward.
I know every flower in this meadow.
The wind off the flower field smells sweet.

lines.zh: 水流往哪边，我就去哪边。
lines.en: Where the current leads, I follow.
The flower field's wind is sweet.
My scales feel cold — a little longer.
The wind is warmer than yesterday.
Who shook these flowers apart?
The flowers along here are thick.
I fly steadier than yesterday.
A flick of my tails and I'm off.
These flowers weren't open yesterday.
Follow my wings—don't fall behind.
Past this flower field, I'll rest.

lines.zh: 头顶的太阳，晃得我眼花。
lines.en: The sun overhead dazzles me.
This flower looks like a lamp.
I settle on a single petal.

lines.zh: 露水里，我的黑翅在看我。
lines.en: In the dew, my black wings watch me.
Which flower am I up to?
I'm waiting for a flower to open.

lines.zh: 花海这么大，我绕了三圈。
lines.en: The flower field's so wide I've circled it thrice.
Wings closed, I'll doze a while.
A dewdrop bursts; another forms.
Petals are softer than moss.

lines.zh: 黑翅一收，我落在花瓣上。
lines.en: Black wings fold and I land on a petal.

lines.zh: 黑色翅上，落满了黄色的粉。
lines.en: Yellow pollen coats my black wings.
Staying on this flower is fine.
I should find another branch.
Nights in woods last so long.
I'll stay on the flower—you stay still.

lines.zh: 森林的花，我一天要跑好几处。
lines.en: I visit several forest flowers a day.
Hide in the flowers, or watch?
You're not a flower, nor a leaf.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的黑，是花海给的。
lines.en: The black on my wings came from the flower fields.
You're so tall—like a tree.

lines.zh: 花海里的光，被你挡住了。
lines.en: You're blocking the light in the flower field.

lines.zh: 花海里的风，最适合我飘。
lines.en: The wind over the flower field suits my drifting.

lines.zh: 我尾翅上那点蓝，是花海给的。
lines.en: The blue on my tails came from the flower field.
Your hands smell of flower sap.
One more touch and the wing tears.
Your grime is on my white spots.
One of my white spots is smudged.

lines.zh: 翅膀缺了一角，飞不直了。
lines.en: A corner of my wing is gone — I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 花海的风，把我吹得打转。
lines.en: The flower-field wind spins me around.
My wing pattern isn't torn yet.

lines.zh: 黑翅一收，我就藏进花里。
lines.en: Folded black wings hide me in the flowers.
A tear in my wing membrane.
Easy—my wings are membrane.

lines.zh: 谁在这儿撒了粘的东西？
lines.en: Who spread something sticky here?

lines.zh: 明知道是圈套，还是想近。
lines.en: I know it's a trap, and still lean in.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的翅跟一步。
lines.en: You step back; my wings follow.
My proboscis unrolls just once.
My proboscis reached out before I thought.
Is that really nectar?
Just one sniff of nectar, truly.
That drop on your fingertip—mine.
Who scattered this? The whole patch is sweet.

lines.zh: 让我落在你肩上一会儿就好。
lines.en: Let me rest on your shoulder a moment.
The sweetness of rotting fruit!

lines.zh: 黑翅上的纹，像燕子的尾。
lines.en: The marks on my black wings look like a swallow's tail.

lines.zh: 黑翅上的白斑是我的记号。
lines.en: White spots on black wings mark me.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的鳞粉全被撞散了。
lines.en: My wing dust scattered from the bump.
In the flower sea, I hit a wing.
A knock sent my black wings askew.

lines.zh: 我的黑翅上，点着几点白。
lines.en: A few white dots on my black wings.
Over the flower fields, my black shines.
A little hole burned in my wing.
Who bumps me while I drift through flowers?
It does not hurt, it just stings my pride.
I built a nest on a leaf's underside.
This flower cluster is ours.
The red on your wings is like dusk.
We'll guard these eggs together.
My wings are humming—can you hear?

lines.zh: 跟我一起落在向日葵上。
lines.en: Land on the sunflower with me.

lines.zh: 花海的风，把我们一群都抬起来。
lines.en: The flower-field wind lifts our whole flock.
Rest on this flower with me.
Your colours are like sunset clouds.
Flowers by the water weeds guide me.
I could trade a bee for some honey.
In the flower fields, black wings stand out.
It doesn't feel like a petal.
If it can bed a flower, I'll keep it.
You dropped it—I'll pass it back on my wings.
Pressed under the flowerpot.
Held in my wings, it's heavy.
I'll keep it—it'll be useful.
This pollen is mine to keep.
My wings are full—I can barely fly.
The black wings in the flower field are mine.
Today's nectar will fill me.
That flower—hold still, I'm landing.
I landed on the flower and it didn't notice.
Beneath black wings, my eyes have it.
This drop of nectar feeds me all day.
An aphid—right there.
That dark patch on the stone is me.
It hasn't seen me — wings folded first.
The insect moved; so did my wings.
Do not run; the reflection in the water is me.
Over the flower field I beat my black wings.
Run—the flower field is only so big.
One more flower's distance.

lines.zh: 黑翅一合，我就是片叶子。
lines.en: Wings folded, I am just a leaf.

lines.zh: 花海的风，一阵比一阵大。
lines.en: The flower field wind grows stronger.
Don't go where the flowers thin out!
In the flower field, you can't escape.
I won't stop till the flower's bare.
However hard the wind blows, I keep up.
Get out of this flower field.
Stay away from my flower.
You'd touch the flower I rest on?
Steal my nectar and I get cross.
Under black wings, blue hides.
Don't grab my wings.
The dust from my wing edge will itch.
The orange spot on my wing tip is a warning.
I'll send you cooling under the flowers.
The yellow spots on my wingtips are a warning.

lines.zh: 我停在花瓣上，翅膀一开一合。
lines.en: I rest on a petal, wings opening and closing.
The flowers swayed, and out I came.
I know this flower field.
The blooms are too still—odd.
How did I land on this one?
New flowers, new scents.

lines.zh: 林子里没有水，我照样飞。
lines.en: No water in the forest. I fly anyway.
The wind is warm—perfect for spreading wings.
Where am I? Such white flowers.

lines.zh: 我从花丛里出来了，谁等我？
lines.en: I am out of the flowers, who is waiting?
Hot! The wing edge is curling!
The wind stopped, so down I drop.
My wings are wet—I can't fly.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被震得翻过来了。
lines.en: The blast flipped my wings over.

lines.zh: 那支箭擦过翅尖，差点穿洞。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my wingtip, almost a hole.
My black wings shake and shed dust.
Not enough nectar—my wings feel soft.
The scales on my wings still tingle.
So black I can't see my own wings.
